visual_brief: Landmark 81 is a blue-silver cluster of rectangular shafts with staggered setbacks, strong vertical ribs and a long open-lattice spire. It dominates the shorter Vinhomes Central Park apartment towers beside the Saigon River; classic views are across the river or from the park, especially at illuminated dusk. Do not confuse it with Bitexco's curved tower and projecting helipad, the neighbouring residential blocks, or the more smoothly tapering Burj Khalifa.
notes: Six candidates retained after rejecting hazy, heavily obscured and cropped alternatives. Recommended: c6, then c2 and c4; several views have minor base occlusion, stated individually. Original-size JPEGs decoded and visually inspected; no watermarks or added text overlays found. Licence strings reproduce source-page labels, which link to the Pexels terms: https://www.pexels.com/license/. References were viewed only, never copied or downloaded.
